description: Creates one private endpoint for the specified cloud service provider. At this current version only AWS is supported. Source:- https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources/tree/master/cfn-resources/private-endpoint-aws

Profile.description: The profile is defined in AWS Secret manager. See [Secret Manager Profile setup](../../../examples/profile-secret.yaml)

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project.

EndpointServiceId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the private endpoint service for which you want to create a private endpoint.

Id.description: Unique string that identifies the private endpoint. for AWS is the VPC endpoint ID, example: vpce-xxxxxxxx

EnforceConnectionSuccess.description: If this proper is set to TRUE, the cloud formation resource will return success Only if the private connection is Succeeded

title: MongoDBAtlasPrivateEndpointAWSProperties
